name: MRZ Passport Autofill
description: Paste a passport screenshot, decode the MRZ with local OCR, and autofill the current form. Fully offline. Nothing is stored or sent.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self'
